record.reason: CogniGraph hierarchically indexes session summaries, triples and source chunks, with time-aware retrieval/reranking and incremental updates. LoCoMo and LongMemEval report accuracy, prompt tokens and retrieval latency gains; evidence is specifically dialogue memory, so validate on inference serving/KV workflows before treating as a runtime optimization.
record.title: LiCoMemory: Lightweight and Cognitive Agentic Memory for Efficient Long-Term Reasoning
